definitions.explanation: Indicates a time point and everything following it. The starting point is typically included.

examples.japanese: 10⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧{以降|いこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}かに→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧{以降|いこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しく→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: From next week onward, I'll be busy.

examples.japanese: 2020⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧{以降|いこう}、⟦{在宅|ざいたく}→在宅：07696_zaitaku⟧⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。

notes:
USAGE: Attached to time expressions to indicate 'from that point onward.' The reference point is usually included.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Time + {以降|いこう} (from [time] onward)
- {以降|いこう} at the start of a sentence (from then on)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{以来|いらい}→以来：01831_irai⟧ (since - emphasizes continuation from the past)
- ⟦{以後|いご}→以後：01710_igo⟧ (after - slightly more formal)
- ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧ (after - more casual)

NOTE: {以降|いこう} typically includes the reference point, so 10⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧{以降|いこう} means '10 o'clock and after.'
